purpose: Actual-source AI evaluation inputs; not a completed model evaluation

Conditional external collection when available; bounded hold otherwise

cases.input: 내부 폭이 얼마고 선반 간격을 몇 mm로 바꾸면 조명 가림이 해결돼?

No invented shelf spacing or measured light improvement
